spec.description: n8n, Hermes Agent, Hermes Kanban, OpenViking 및 Codex·Claude·Antigravity 구독 사용량 통합 모니터링 대시보드.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', ended_at) AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND status IN ('completed', 'failed')
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

spec.description: 완료, 실패 추세
spec.title: 완료, 실패 추세

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  tools.key AS tool,
  sum(tools.value::bigint) AS calls
FROM observability.hermes_runs AS runs
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(runs.tool_usage) AS tools
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(runs.ended_at, runs.started_at))
  AND runs.profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND runs.model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY tools.key
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 15;

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ended_at AS "시각",
  profile AS "프로필",
  model AS "모델",
  source AS "소스",
  end_reason AS "종료 사유",
  round((duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "처리시간(초)"
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at))
  AND status = 'failed'
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
ORDER BY COALESCE(ended_at, started_at) DESC
LIMIT 20;

spec.description: 최근 실패 상세
spec.title: 최근 실패 상세

spec.rawSql:
WITH profile_model_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    model,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(avg(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    )::numeric, 0) AS avg_tokens_per_run,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds,
    round(COALESCE(
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)
        FILTER (
          WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
            AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
        ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS p95_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile, model
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
)
SELECT
  p.profile AS "프로필",
  p.model AS "모델",
  p.run_count AS "실행 수",
  p.total_tokens AS "총 토큰",
  p.avg_tokens_per_run AS "실행당 평균 토큰",
  p.general_seconds AS "일반 작업(초)",
  COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0) AS "칸반 작업(초)",
  round((p.general_seconds + COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "전체 작업(초)"
FROM profile_model_usage p
LEFT JOIN kanban_usage k ON k.profile = p.profile
ORDER BY p.profile, "총 토큰" DESC;

spec.description: 프로필 별 모델 사용량
spec.title: 프로필 별 모델 사용량

spec.rawSql:
WITH general_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    COALESCE(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(reasoning_tokens), 0) AS reasoning_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(COALESCE(
      100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens)
      / NULLIF(sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0),
      0
    ), 1) AS cache_hit_rate,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(g.profile, k.profile) AS "프로필",
  COALESCE(g.input_tokens, 0) AS "일반 입력 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.cache_read_tokens, 0) AS "캐시 읽기 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.output_tokens, 0) AS "출력 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.reasoning_tokens, 0) AS "리즈닝 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.total_tokens, 0) AS "총 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.cache_hit_rate, 0) AS "캐시 적중률",
  COALESCE(g.general_seconds, 0) AS "일반 작업(초)",
  COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0) AS "칸반 작업(초)",
  round((
    COALESCE(g.general_seconds, 0)
    + COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "전체 작업(초)"
FROM general_usage g
FULL OUTER JOIN kanban_usage k ON k.profile = g.profile
ORDER BY "전체 작업(초)" DESC, "총 토큰" DESC;

spec.description: 실행 수
spec.title: 실행 수

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_rate FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS running FROM execution_entity WHERE status = 'running'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM execution_entity WHERE status IN ('error','failed') AND "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT date_trunc('hour', "stoppedAt") AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS success, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('error','failed')) AS failure, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running') AS running FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', "stoppedAt") AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "stoppedAt" - "startedAt")) AS p50_seconds, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "stoppedAt" - "startedAt")) AS p95_seconds FROM execution_entity WHERE "startedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "stoppedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS executions FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY status ORDER BY executions DESC

SELECT COALESCE(w.name, e."workflowId") AS workflow, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'success') AS success, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_rate FROM execution_entity e LEFT JOIN workflow_entity w ON w.id = e."workflowId" WHERE e."stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY w.name, e."workflowId" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT "stoppedAt" AS time, COALESCE(w.name, e."workflowId") AS workflow, e.status, e.id AS execution_id FROM execution_entity e LEFT JOIN workflow_entity w ON w.id = e."workflowId" WHERE e.status IN ('error','failed') AND e."stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY e."stoppedAt" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

options.content:
### 데이터 수집 지표

워크플로우 이름/ID 매핑과 item 수 telemetry가 아직 확정되지 않아 이 영역은 비워 둡니다.

> `workflow_entity` 매핑 후 별도 패널로 추가하세요. 추정값이나 mock 데이터는 표시하지 않습니다.

### 외부 API 오류

현재 `execution_entity`만으로는 HTTP status·retry를 신뢰성 있게 구분할 수 없습니다.

> `execution_data` 또는 별도 telemetry(event_type, status_code, retry_count)가 연결되면 이 영역을 쿼리 패널로 교체하세요.

SELECT
  profile AS "프로필",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS "완료",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS "미종료",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS "실패",
  round(COALESCE(
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')
    / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')), 0),
    0
  )::numeric, 1) AS "실패율"
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY profile
ORDER BY "실패율" DESC, "실패" DESC, profile;

SELECT

  usage_date::timestamptz AS time,
  agent || ' / ' || model AS metric,
  sum(total_tokens)::double precision AS value

spec.title: Orca 토큰 사용 추이

spec.rawSql:
WITH skill_summary AS (
  SELECT
    d.agent,
    d.thread_id,
    string_agg(DISTINCT skill.value, ', ' ORDER BY skill.value) AS skill_names
  FROM observability.orca_thread_usage_daily d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(d.skill_names) AS skill(value)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d.usage_date::timestamptz)
  GROUP BY d.agent, d.thread_id
)
SELECT
  u.agent AS "에이전트",
  u.project_label AS "프로젝트",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(max(u.thread_name), ''), u.thread_id) AS "쓰레드",
  COALESCE(max(skill_summary.skill_names), '—') AS "참조 스킬",
  u.model AS "모델",
  sum(u.request_count) AS "모델 호출 수",
  sum(u.input_tokens) AS "입력 토큰",
  sum(u.cache_read_tokens) AS "캐시 읽기",
  sum(u.cache_write_tokens) AS "캐시 쓰기",
  sum(u.output_tokens) AS "출력 토큰",
  sum(u.reasoning_tokens) AS "리즈닝 토큰",
  sum(u.total_tokens) AS "총 토큰"
FROM observability.orca_thread_usage_daily u
LEFT JOIN skill_summary
  ON skill_summary.agent = u.agent AND skill_summary.thread_id = u.thread_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.usage_date::timestamptz)
GROUP BY u.agent, u.project_label, u.thread_id, u.model
ORDER BY "총 토큰" DESC;

WITH model_usage AS (
  SELECT
    model,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(avg(

      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    )::numeric, 0) AS avg_tokens_per_run,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds,
    round(COALESCE(
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)
        FILTER (
          WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
            AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
        ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS p95_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY model
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
)
SELECT
  m.model AS "모델",
  m.run_count AS "실행 수",

spec.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT d::date AS day
  FROM generate_series(now()::date - 6, now()::date, interval '1 day') AS d
),
usage AS (
  SELECT usage_date, agent, sum(total_tokens)::double precision AS tokens
  FROM observability.orca_usage_daily
  WHERE usage_date BETWEEN (SELECT min(day) FROM days) AND (SELECT max(day) FROM days)
  GROUP BY usage_date, agent
)
SELECT
  (ARRAY['월','화','수','목','금','토','일'])[extract(isodow FROM d.day)::int] || ' ' || to_char(d.day, 'MM-DD') AS "요일",
  COALESCE(sum(u.tokens) FILTER (WHERE u.agent = 'codex'), 0) AS "Codex",
  COALESCE(sum(u.tokens) FILTER (WHERE u.agent = 'claude'), 0) AS "Claude",
  COALESCE(sum(u.tokens) FILTER (WHERE u.agent = 'antigravity'), 0) AS "Antigravity"
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.usage_date = d.day
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day;

spec.description: ORCA 작업 폴더에서 쓴 Codex·Claude·Antigravity 토큰을 최근 7일 동안 하루 단위로 보여 줍니다. 오늘을 포함하므로 마지막 막대는 아직 집계 중인 값입니다. 대시보드 시간 범위와 관계없이 항상 최근 7일을 기준으로 합니다.
spec.title: 요일별 토큰 사용량 (최근 7일)

spec.description: 하루(한국 시간 00:00~24:00) 동안 각 구독의 주간 사용률이 몇 %p 늘었는지 보여 줍니다. 5분 간격 증가분만 더하므로 주간 초기화로 값이 떨어진 구간은 0으로 처리합니다. Prometheus 구독 지표는 2026-10-01부터 쌓이므로 그 이전 날짜는 비어 있습니다. 오늘 막대는 집계 중인 값입니다.
spec.title: 요일별 주간 사용률 증가 (최근 7일)

spec.description: Codex 구독의 장기 사용 구간 소진율입니다. codex app-server의 secondary rate-limit 구간을 exporter가 weekly로 정규화합니다. 초기화 시각이 지난 구간은 새 값이 들어올 때까지 갱신 대기로 표시합니다.
spec.title: Codex · 주간 사용률

spec.description: Claude 구독의 5시간 사용 구간 소진율입니다. 로그인된 Claude Code의 /usage 결과를 exporter가 정규화합니다. 초기화 시각이 지난 구간은 새 값이 들어올 때까지 갱신 대기로 표시합니다.
spec.title: Claude · 5시간 사용률

spec.description: Claude 구독의 주간 사용 구간 소진율입니다. 로그인된 Claude Code의 /usage 결과를 exporter가 정규화합니다. 초기화 시각이 지난 구간은 새 값이 들어올 때까지 갱신 대기로 표시합니다.
spec.title: Claude · 주간 사용률

spec.name: board

spec.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE status
    WHEN 'done' THEN '완료'
    WHEN 'archived' THEN '보관'
    WHEN 'blocked' THEN '차단'
    WHEN 'running' THEN '실행 중'
    WHEN 'triage' THEN '검토'
    ELSE status
  END AS __text,
  status AS __value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
ORDER BY 1;
